$comment: ADR-0015. allowlist applies to shipped code (prod npm deps, Swift packages, fonts); denyPattern fails anywhere in the tree. Exceptions need the product owner's approval and are listed with a reason; an exception with "status": "pending" is tolerated by the check but printed loudly until the product owner approves or rejects it.

exceptions.reason: SIL Open Font License accepted for font files only (KaTeX fonts).

exceptions.name: elkjs
exceptions.reason: Eclipse Layout Kernel (taken under EPL-2.0, a weak file-level copyleft) is compiled unmodified into mermaid.min.js 12.x, vendored for offline Mermaid documents (ADR-0008). Accepted for this bundle only (ADR-0027); EPL-2.0 is not on the general allowlist. Its notice and license text are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

licenseOverrides.name: khroma
licenseOverrides.reason: package.json has no license field; the package ships an MIT license file (dependency of mermaid).
